title: SHARDOR One Touch Coffee Grinder Electric, Spice, Herb, For Coffee Bean Spices and Seeds with 1 Removable Stainless Steel Bowl, Dry Grinder, Black
description:
About this item
Press to Start: When you press down on the button, the machine starts grinding; releasing your finger stops the grinding. The longer you grind, the finer the result.
Super Silent:The average noise is 60 dB, which is quieter than other coffee grinders.
Removable Stainless Steel Cup: The stainless steel cup is removable for easy filling and pouring and is dishwasher safe.
Multi-functional Coffee Grinder: With the upgraded stainless steel blades, this grinder makes easy work of grinding everything from coffee beans to spices and other dry ingredients, such as herbs, pepper, cinnamon, anise, flaxseed, nuts and coarse salt.
Worry-Free Purchase: 2-YEAR MANUFACTURER'S WARRANTY! We are so confident in our coffee grinders that our track record speaks for itself.

I don't grind coffee, but I do grind seeds like flax, hemp, and chia. I previously had a coffee bean grinder where the cup was integrated into the base. It meant that I could never clean the cup well. With the design of the lid on my old grinder, it also meant that I would get seed pieces outside of the grinding chamber.

It makes a world of difference to have a grinder like this where the cup is removeable and even has its own lid. The lid rim on Shardor's grinder sits inside the top of the grinding cup and there is even an outer lid that goes over the cup and its lid. Since the parts that contact food are dishwasher safe, cleaning is so much easier. Previously, I was limited in what I could grind after using it for oily seeds. Now, since I can wash this one properly, I can grind other foods even after using it with seeds. The grinder motor is quiet, but as with any grinder, it does make more noise as food flies around inside it.

5 stars
No complaints so far and using it has been wonderful. It's possible that I would be just as happy with another grinder that had a removeable bowl and lid. This is the only such grinder I have had the chance to use, though. My only regret currently is that the company does not seem to sell replacement bowls and lids for this, at least not on Amazon. I'd love to buy a couple of replacements so I could just store the seeds in them after grinding. I know that they lose nutrients as they sit around, but I don't always judge how much to grind correctly.I’m thrilled with this coffee grinder. Very basic and has one setting and one purpose but it works well.

The removable container is why I like this so much. It is great to be able to grind coffee beans and then bring just the little container over to fill my coffee.

The fact that the container has a lid is also fantastic. I can grind some coffee ahead of time and keep it in the container till I’m ready to use. The lid actually goes on tightly!

I will say that this isn’t “Super Silent” like it states in the listing. It sounds like most of my other coffee grinders. Not sure which ones they compared it to but it isn’t silent at all. I’m not complaining because I don’t know how you can grind coffee beans and have it not be noisy. Just wanted to point this out.

It does a good job grinding. I have only used this for coffee beans so far and I have gotten the process down to know how long to grind it for based on has fine or corse I want the coffee.

I’m very happy with this and am using it more often than previous coffee grinders because of the convenience.
